question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.striker AS player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
    WHERE bs.runs_scored > 0
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
),
player_team_info AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.match_id,
        pr.player_id,
        pr.total_runs,
        pm.team_id
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_match pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id AND pr.player_id = pm.player_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.player_name
FROM player_team_info pt
JOIN player p ON pt.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON pt.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pt.total_runs >= 100
AND pt.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
